assessment_scope: AIGC autopoietic sovereign ecosystem V1 slice only

capabilities.name: Non-self-amendable effect and authority policy
limitations: No distributed policy service
No cryptographic operator signatures

capabilities.name: Sealed exact-revision objective contracts
limitations: Canonical objective registry not connected

capabilities.name: Typed quality, throughput, latency, reliability, drift, cost, security and portability telemetry
limitations: Authenticated distributed telemetry adapters not implemented

capabilities.name: Deterministic fitness and deficit formulation
limitations: Fitness functions remain policy-defined approximations

capabilities.name: Deterministic candidate synthesis from typed templates
limitations: No free-form model-generated code synthesis in this slice

capabilities.name: Independent hard-gate verifier
limitations: Independent verifier is a separate identity and function, not a physically isolated service

capabilities.name: Reversible idempotent local shadow execution
limitations: In-memory only
No OS-level container or WASM isolation

capabilities.name: Regression rollback semantics
limitations: External compensating actions are not implemented

capabilities.name: Canonical SHA-256 receipts and predecessor chain
limitations: Receipts are hashed but not yet digitally signed

capabilities.name: Emergency stop before planning or execution
limitations: Distributed propagation not implemented

capabilities.name: Deterministic provider-neutral adapter routing
limitations: Reference manifests are not production adapter certifications

capabilities.name: Replaceable local and remote model protocols
limitations: No model invocation performed
No benchmark-based adapter certification

capabilities.name: Text, audio, image, video, 3D, tactile and code artifact alignment
limitations: Modality engines and cross-modal validators remain future slices

capabilities.name: CPU, GPU, NPU, TPU, WebGPU and WASM abstraction
limitations: No heterogeneous distributed scheduler or hardware benchmark receipt

capabilities.name: Sovereign open-format data and synthetic-data governance
limitations: No corpus generator, contamination scanner or durable content-addressed store

capabilities.name: Transactional persistent state, lease and idempotency storage
limitations: Current reference state and receipt ledger are in memory

capabilities.name: Zero-downtime service or model hot swapping
limitations: Only logical local shadow promotion is implemented

capabilities.name: Cross-platform approvals, health, receipts and rollback interface
limitations: No web, mobile or desktop UI in this slice

capabilities.name: No-traffic staging and governed production deployment
limitations: No cloud mutation
No public traffic
No production receipt

capabilities.name: Ecosystem capable of rebuilding every dependency from its own verified sources
limitations: Python runtime and third-party dependencies remain external bootstrap components
